request.substack_media_readback: Return public_image_urls observed on the exact canonical page; the existing media owner verifies original bytes before derivative delivery.

browser_workspace.window: Use the one existing BrowserOS Neo window. Create one only if none exists.
browser_workspace.tabs: Open tabs with tabs action=new and groupId in this task's group, titled Capital Chronicle/<task>. Leave Jim's and other agents' tabs untouched.

composed_run.one_run: One BrowserOS Neo run script does all five steps in this order, in this task's tab. It replaces the request's steps list: no separate identity, snapshot or binding step first.

1_identity.rule: Read the signed-in account and compare it with the expected identity and stable id. While in this identity or any other pre-write part, result.stage is BEFORE_PUBLISH_CLICK. A mismatch or an unreadable identity returns FAILED_BEFORE_WRITE with definite_no_write true, stage BEFORE_PUBLISH_CLICK and no click.

composed_run.2_compose: Enter each post below in its own composer box, in order, with its bound media. For a thread, add each next box with the composer's add-post control and wait until that box exists and has focus; then enter the post's whole text in one operation, newlines included. Never enter a post paragraph by paragraph, or before its box is ready.

3_verify_before_click.rule: Before the click, read every composer box's text back and compare it with its post, with whitespace collapsed and a link allowed to render shortened. Every post must match, in order, with no box missing or extra. Re-enter a box that differs once and compare again. If any post still differs, return FAILED_BEFORE_WRITE with definite_no_write true, stage BEFORE_PUBLISH_CLICK and no click.

composed_run.4_publish: Immediately BEFORE the publish click, set the observation's dispatched_at_utc and result.stage = PUBLISH_CLICK_ATTEMPTED; then click once to publish the exact payload.
composed_run.5_readback: Right after the click, in the same run, read back the published object (id, url, text, media) and return it as composed.readback. This readback confirms the destination: no separate readback turn follows, and the next destination's run starts after it.

return.result: the publish result, as for any PUBLISH step, with its stage

composed.pre_click_posts: REQUIRED with any write: the composer texts read in step 3, in order. A return without them is refused; if they were not read, submit nothing
composed.readback: REQUIRED with any write: the READBACK result fields (status, observed_identity, public_object_id, public_object_url, observed_text, content_verified, media) observed in this run after the click. A return without it is refused

composed_run.after_click: FAILED_BEFORE_WRITE is a definite no-write only for an account mismatch or stage BEFORE_PUBLISH_CLICK. Any other failure, including a missing stage, is UNKNOWN_WRITE; the coordinator reads back before any retry.
composed_run.after_run: Submit this run's return at once, then start the next destination's run. Extra checks of a destination already read back (media comparisons, evidence files, commits) wait until every destination has gone out.
